name: vimalnath-deploy
description: Deployment: the admin on a Cloudflare Worker (passing /v1 to the API), the app's web version on another Worker, and the API as a Neon Function.

scripts.deploy:admin: npm --prefix ../admin run build && wrangler deploy --config admin.jsonc
scripts.deploy:app: cd .. && npx expo export -p web --output-dir dist && cd deploy && wrangler deploy --config app.jsonc
scripts.deploy:function: npm run build:function && npx -y neon@latest functions deploy api --src function --no-bundle --project-id empty-paper-39101544 --branch main
